name: mlx-swift
description: The foundational Node.js bridge to Apple's MLX framework via Swift. Native Apple Silicon acceleration with zero-dependency Node-API bindings.

scripts.build:swift: b() { set -e; swift build --configuration release "$@"; find .build -name "lib$(swift package dump-package | jq -r .name).a" -exec cp {} ./mlx.a \;; }; b
scripts.build:metal: set -e; cd .build/checkouts/mlx-swift; xcodebuild build -scheme MLX -destination 'generic/platform=macOS,variant=macos' -derivedDataPath ../../../.xcode -quiet CONFIGURATION=Release; find ../../../.xcode -name default.metallib -exec cp {} ../../../default.metallib \;
scripts.build: npm run build:swift && npm run build:metal && npm run build:clang
